explanation: Bounds complete source-control storage while keeping the base address affine. The explicit encoder multiplier includes both the source-bank storage and the compact-width control tables.
theorem_title: Source-control storage fits the encoder envelope
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceControlCosts.space_le_encoderCount {base NL NR n p U D : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hNL : NL ≤ n) (hNR : NR ≤ n) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSourceControlsHost.space base NL NR (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandScales.bandSize n) p
      (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.microHalf (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.inputBits n)) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.blockCount (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.inputBits n)) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.mu n) U D ≤
      base+(29+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.blockCount (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.inputBits n)+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandBanksCosts.storageFactor n+
          (232*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.mu n+1)^2+(232*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.mu n+1))*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.StageBounds.encoderCount n+
        Nat.log 2 (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.TrimScales.scheduleCount n+1)+
        max (Nat.log 2 (U+1)+2) (Nat.log 2 (p+D+1)+2)+19 := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $n>0$ and $N_L,N_R\le n$, with natural base $b$ and arithmetic controls $p,U,D$. Evaluate the source-control host at the executable band and local parameters. Its required final address is bounded by $b$ plus encoder count times $$29+J+F(n)+(232\mu(n)+1)^2+(232\mu(n)+1),$$ plus $\lfloor\log_2(S(n)+1)\rfloor+\max(\lfloor\log_2(U+1)\rfloor+2,\lfloor\log_2(p+D+1)\rfloor+2)+19$, where $J,F,S$ are block count, storage factor, and schedule count.

Bounds complete source-control storage while keeping the base address affine. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
